<!-- This exercise is authored by Karsten Lübke. -->



```{r data generation, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}
library(exams)
# Random Data
zs <- sample(c(-3:3),1)
sa <- sample(c(1,2,3,5,10),1)
mw <- sample(c(0,10,50,100),1)
x <- mw + zs*sa

questions <- -3:3



solutions <- rep(FALSE, 7)
solutions[which(questions==zs)] <- TRUE
```


Question
========

Welchen z-Wert hat eine Beobachtung mit $$x=`r x`$$ bei einer Normalverteilung mit $\mu=`r mw`$ und $\sigma=`r sa`$?


```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(questions, markup = "markdown")
```



Solution
========


Aufgabenname: `zwert1`



```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(ifelse(solutions, "Richtig", "Falsch"), markup = "markdown")
```
